title: Cards
statementMd:
There are $*n*$ cards ($*n*$ is **even**) in the deck. Each card has a positive integer written on it. $*n* / 2$ people will play new card game. At the beginning of the game each player gets two cards, each card is given to exactly one player.

Find the way to distribute cards such that the sum of values written of the cards will be equal for each player. It is guaranteed that it is always possible.

## Input

The first line of the input contains integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$) — the number of cards in the deck. It is guaranteed that $*n*$ is even.

The second line contains the sequence of $*n*$ positive integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$), where $*a*_{*i*}$ is equal to the number written on the $*i*$-th card.

## Output

Print $*n* / 2$ pairs of integers, the $*i*$-th pair denote the cards that should be given to the $*i*$-th player. Each card should be given to exactly one player. Cards are numbered in the order they appear in the input.

It is guaranteed that solution exists. If there are several correct answers, you are allowed to print any of them.

## Note

In the first sample, cards are distributed in such a way that each player has the sum of numbers written on his cards equal to $8$.

In the second sample, all values $*a*_{*i*}$ are equal. Thus, any distribution is acceptable.
statementZhMd:
牌堆中有 $*n*$ 张牌（$*n*$ 是**偶数**）。每张牌上写有一个正整数。将有 $*n* / 2$ 名玩家参与这个新卡牌游戏。游戏开始时，每位玩家会得到两张牌，每张牌恰好分给一名玩家。

请找出一种分配牌的方式，使得每位玩家手中两张牌上的数字之和相等。保证一定存在满足条件的分配方案。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100$）——牌堆中牌的数量。保证 $*n*$ 是偶数。

第二行包含由 $*n*$ 个正整数组成的序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 100$），其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示第 $*i*$ 张牌上写的数字。

## 输出格式

输出 $*n* / 2$ 对整数，第 $*i*$ 对整数表示应分给第 $*i*$ 位玩家的两张牌。每张牌都必须恰好分给一名玩家。牌的编号按照它们在输入中出现的顺序确定。

保证存在满足条件的方案。如果有多种正确答案，可以输出其中任意一种。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，牌的分配方式使得每位玩家手中牌上数字之和均为 $8$。

在第二个样例中，所有 $*a*_{*i*}$ 的值都相等。因此，任何分配方式都可以接受。
